doc.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Declining to discuss a date with a mystic bandleader
summary: Jones refuses comment on a record date with a mystic, saying only that the checks arrived on time.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Another record I found interesting for whatever reason as a record you did with a gentleman named Dargy.
(Laughs) That’s like the Herman Lubinsky thing.
Right, even more so, or less so. That is beyond discussion.
I went to the internet to find out about this guy. I knew he was some kind of a mystic.

Don’t quote me. (Laughs) I mean…Next! The only good thing about that date was that the checks came in on time. I’ll say no more. . So that's why I don't want to say anything. I don't want to say anything that would impact on somebody's credibility. That is why don't want to comment on it.
You still had some great musicians on that date, Rodney Jones, Ricky Gask and Mickey Roker. Next question. Next issue.
